steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is not blocked.
Change the default event type to RFQ and retain whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the specified product and quantity; the product selection supplies its single Variant 1 variant.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields before scheduling and publishing.
Set the requested delivery location on the first product row.
Add the vendor named in the case to the event audience.
Commit a start-now schedule with the requested 24-hour equivalent duration.
Publish the fully configured RFQ and wait for the publish result.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Verify that the published Project Details view exposes the bidding end field.
Confirm that no application error was shown during scheduling or publishing.
